calculation_description: Current standard methodology for availability SLO attainment.

method_descriptions.all_downtime: All downtime counts equally. Current standard.
method_descriptions.exclude_external_deps: Excludes downtime attributed to third-party dependency failures.
method_descriptions.weighted_by_traffic: Low-traffic windows down-weighted relative to peak.

team_incentive: Bonus pool released if the metric is at or above target at end of the current period
methodology_change_policy: Method change requires Architecture Review Board approval per SRE handbook Section 8.4
note: Metric is short of target this period.
